description: This file defines functions and types for generating, manipulating, and comparing ARIA (Accessible Rich Internet Applications) node snapshots, including rendering ARIA trees, matching templates, and tracking changes between snapshots. It is part of a larger accessibility testing or snapshot system.

classes.name: AriaSnapshot
classes.description: Represents a snapshot of ARIA nodes, including root node, element mappings, references, and iframe references.

classes.name: AriaRef
classes.description: Represents a reference to an ARIA node with role, name, and ref string.

methods.name: toInternalOptions
methods.description: Converts user-specified AriaTreeOptions into internal options used for processing.

methods.name: generateAriaTree
methods.description: Generates an ARIA snapshot tree from a root DOM element based on specified options.

methods.name: computeAriaRef
methods.description: Computes and assigns a reference identifier for an ARIA node based on options.

methods.name: toAriaNode
methods.description: Creates an ARIA node representation from a DOM element, including role, name, and properties.

methods.name: normalizeGenericRoles
methods.description: Normalizes ARIA nodes with 'generic' role, removing redundant or enclosing nodes.

methods.name: normalizeStringChildren
methods.description: Normalizes text children of ARIA nodes, trimming whitespace and removing redundant nodes.

methods.name: matchesStringOrRegex
methods.description: Checks if a string matches a given string or regex pattern.

methods.name: matchesTextValue
methods.description: Checks if a text matches an ARIATextValue pattern or raw string.

methods.name: matchesExpectAriaTemplate
methods.description: Matches a DOM element against an ARIA template, returning matched nodes and received template info.

methods.name: getAllElementsMatchingExpectAriaTemplate
methods.description: Returns all DOM elements matching an ARIA template within a root element.

methods.name: matchesNode
methods.description: Checks if an ARIA node matches an ARIA template node based on role, name, properties, and children.

methods.name: listEqual
methods.description: Checks if two lists of ARIA nodes or strings are equal, optionally deep.

methods.name: containsList
methods.description: Checks if a list of ARIA nodes or strings contains a sequence of template nodes.

methods.name: matchesNodeDeep
methods.description: Recursively finds ARIA nodes matching a template, returning all matches.

methods.name: buildByRefMap
methods.description: Builds a map of ARIA nodes keyed by their ref string.

methods.name: compareSnapshots
methods.description: Compares two ARIA snapshots and returns a map indicating which nodes are same, skipped, or changed.

methods.name: filterSnapshotDiff
methods.description: Filters ARIA nodes to include only changed parts based on a previous snapshot.

methods.name: renderAriaTree
methods.description: Renders an ARIA snapshot as a YAML-like string, optionally showing diffs with previous snapshot.

methods.name: convertToBestGuessRegex
methods.description: Converts a string into a regex pattern with heuristics for dynamic content.

methods.name: textContributesInfo
methods.description: Determines if a text string contributes meaningful info for matching.

methods.name: ariaNodeElement
methods.description: Retrieves the DOM element associated with an ARIA node.

methods.name: setAriaNodeElement
methods.description: Associates a DOM element with an ARIA node.

methods.name: findNewElement
methods.description: Finds a new DOM element corresponding to a changed ARIA node.
